name: MMSU
intro: MMSU 是大规模多任务语音理解与推理基准，包含 5,000 道音频选择题与 47 项任务，覆盖感知、推理、音系、语义和副语言现象。数据由语言学专家设计、三类音频来源和十名标注员多轮质检构成，论文评测 12 个 SpeechLLM 与 10 个 OmniLLM。
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 语音数据, 专家整理
task_type: 音频理解, 语音问答
eval_feature: 语音理解, 语言学现象, 感知与推理
eval_feature_en: Spoken understanding, linguistic phenomena, perception and reasoning
intro_en: MMSU is a massive multitask spoken-language understanding and reasoning benchmark with 5,000 audio MCQs across 47 tasks. Its expert-designed linguistic framework, three audio-source routes, and multi-round review by ten annotators cover perception, reasoning, phonology, semantics, and paralinguistics; the paper evaluates 12 SpeechLLMs and 10 OmniLLMs.

flowchart LR

    E --> F["12 SpeechLLMs plus 10 OmniLLMs"]
    F --> G["Randomized balanced A-D choices"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.04779 Sections 3-4 and Appendix C. The diagram preserves the four construction stages, six linguistic subfields, expert-in-loop GPT-4o option augmentation, exact 3,837/672/491 audio-source counts, professional and 15-speaker custom recording routes, Azure's 20 voices, ten-annotator review, 5,000-item and 2,580/2,420 splits, and the corrected 22-model evaluation of 12 SpeechLLMs plus 10 OmniLLMs.
